name: Supplier documents to SKUs
summary: Takes supplier bills into the accounting system, matches each bill line to a SKU (an item code in Xero), flags unmatched lines and price changes for a person, and queues each clean bill for authorisation. Crons read and draft; a person authorises every bill.

all.evidence: 3 process descriptions across print manufacturing, steel trading and concrete batching

covered_by.doc-intake: intake (supplier bills land in Xero as drafts)
covered_by.read-and-extract: match (bill lines against Xero items; reading the PDF itself is a skill step)
covered_by.check-and-approve: approval (a person reviews the flagged bills and the queued ones)
covered_by.other: not yet (attaching the supplier PDF needs a raw upload the SDK does not send)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New supplier bills that are drafts in Xero.

crons.name: match
crons.summary: Match each bill line to a Xero item (SKU) and flag unmatched lines and price changes.

crons.name: publish
crons.summary: Queue each clean bill for authorisation in Xero, and record what the approver did.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads plus the store's own records. Nothing a cron runs here changes a bill or an item in Xero. Authorising a bill (it becomes payable) is a live operation and waits for a person.

xero.covers: draft purchase bills in, item list as the SKU list, authorising a bill

gaps: Unleashed: the SKU master and purchase orders most of these businesses run on, but its request signing (HMAC-SHA256) is not built in the kit, so no adapter can call it yet. Its docs read is in the endpoint map (status docs-read).
Dext: a bill capture tool for bookkeepers. Its intake (email, Dropbox, PayPal) and its line extraction are described in the docs, but it is not in core/sdk/platforms, so no adapter.
MRPeasy: its docs are in the endpoint map (status docs-read) and it can create products, but it is not in core/sdk/platforms, so no adapter.
Acumatica and PrintIQ, which the calls name for publishing and for supplier invoices against purchase orders: neither is in core/sdk/platforms.
Microsoft 365 spreadsheet route (an Excel table as the register and the SKU list): the kit has the platform, but this build adds only the Xero adapter.
Attaching the supplier PDF to the Xero bill: the attachment endpoint takes raw file bytes, and the SDK sends JSON bodies only. Needs a runtime change in core/, so it is not built.

A bill changed in Xero after matching is held (needs-review, with the change noted) and is not matched again. No command clears that hold yet: a person must clear the stored change before the bill can be queued. Needs a runtime command in core/.
Matching a bill to a purchase order before it is accepted: not built.
Units of measure, pack sizes and conversions: none of the evidence covers them, so a bill line is taken as billed.
Reading the supplier PDF for lines the bill does not carry (scanned invoices): a skill step, described in SKILL.md.
The Xero adapter is docs-only until a Xero demo company proves it.

evidence.calls: 7 calls read for manufacturing supplier documents, 3 describe the process, 0 rejected
evidence.platforms: dext, mrpeasy and unleashed help docs and endpoint maps read; Xero fields confirmed against Xero's official accounting spec
